titulo.estudio: Un guide de visite : Lire l'ensemble

intro: Link timetables, services and access conditions in a tourist guide. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Link timetables, services and access conditions in a tourist guide. Link the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Point to note: the relative pronouns « qui » and « où » connect an attraction with a feature or a place. In this passage, «visite» means «visit».

frases.estudio: Le musée des Arts, qui se trouve près du canal, est ouvert tous les jours sauf le mardi.
frases.alumno: The Museum of Arts, which is near the canal, is open every day except Tuesday.

frases.estudio: La visite guidée commence à onze heures et dure environ cinquante minutes.
frases.alumno: The guided tour starts at eleven and lasts about fifty minutes.

frases.estudio: L'entrée est gratuite pour les moins de dix-huit ans; le billet s'achète à l'accueil.
frases.alumno: Entry is free for under-eighteens; tickets are bought at reception.

frases.estudio: Un ascenseur permet d'accéder aux salles du premier étage.
frases.alumno: A lift gives access to the rooms on the first floor.
